item.title: Former Plaza Towers owner pleads guilty to federal gun charges
item.description: Marco Denis, the former owner of Springfield Plaza Towers, pleaded guilty to illegal possession of a firearm and tax fraud, and faces up to 15 years in prison for the firearm charge and up to 3 years for the tax fraud charge.

item.title: Buckle up, temperatures to take us on a roller coaster ride
item.description: Afternoon sunshine cleared out the December gloom, with temperatures expected to rise to levels not seen since before Thanksgiving, before another cold front brings colder weather and gusty winds on Wednesday.

item.title: December delights with another dazzling sky show
item.description: The Geminids Meteor Shower will peak this Sunday morning, caused by debris from the asteroid 3200 Phaethon, and can be viewed from a rural location with up to 120 meteors per hour.

item.title: Bradleyville boy starts his own Christmas tradition with Christmas inflatables
item.description: A 7-year-old boy from Bradleyville, Missouri, has created a Christmas tradition of collecting inflatable decorations, which has grown to 28 inflatables and become a local attraction.

item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Dec. 1-5
item.description: Out of 52 restaurants inspected in Springfield, Missouri from Dec. 1-5, 2025, 6 priority violations were found, as well as 22 priority violations and 23 nonpriority violations at various other establishments, all of which were corrected on site.
